<div class="howto"><p><b>Today's move.</b> 100 − 1: the ones rod is empty, so add 9, then borrow 1 from the tens. Write what the beads show.</p><p><b>Stuck?</b> Big friends make 10: 1 and 9, 2 and 8, 3 and 7, 4 and 6, 5 and 5. Cannot add 8? Take away 2 and carry 1 to the left.</p></div>
